playstyle.identity: Vi is a diving bruiser who punches through anything to reach her target. Her ultimate is unstoppable and guarantees reaching the backline.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive shields on ability hit. Q charges a dash that knocks back (longer charge = more distance). W shreds armor with hits. E empowers autos with AoE. R is unstoppable - dash to target, knocking aside anyone in the way, then knockup. R to reach carries.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vi spikes at level 6 with her guaranteed engage. Eclipse and bruiser items scale her. She's strong at diving priority targets.

passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.summary: Gain a shield when hitting with an ability.
passive.details: Vi gains a shield when she hits an enemy with an ability. Has a cooldown.

abilities.name: Vault Breaker
abilities.summary: Charge and dash forward, knocking back enemies.
abilities.details: Vi charges up a dash. On release, she dashes forward, damaging and knocking back all enemies hit.

abilities.name: Denting Blows
abilities.summary: Every third hit shreds armor and deals percent max health damage.
abilities.details: Every third attack on the same target deals bonus percent max health damage and reduces their armor.

abilities.name: Relentless Force
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal AoE damage.
abilities.details: Vi empowers her next auto attack to deal bonus damage in a cone behind the target.

abilities.name: Assault and Battery
abilities.summary: Dash to a target unstoppably, knocking aside enemies and suppressing on arrival.
abilities.details: Vi becomes unstoppable and dashes to an enemy champion, knocking aside anyone in her way. On arrival, she knocks up and damages the target.
